people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.
translations.bsb: So they fled before the men of Israel toward the wilderness, but the battle overtook them, and the men coming out of the cities struck them down there.
